title: swarm_wait
description: Put the agent to sleep until a new message is posted on the swarm board. Consumes zero tokens while sleeping.

since.description: Highest message sequence number the caller has actually seen/processed.

mentions_only.description: If true, wake only when mentioned directly (@<name>), via @all, or via member's channel. If false, wake on any post.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait before waking automatically.
